name: claude-session-monitor
description: See at a glance which Claude Code chats need you, which are working, and which are idle.

commands.title: Claude Sessions: Go to the Chat That Needs You

colors.description: A busy session whose status has not changed in a while.
A session working on its own.
A session with nothing in flight.

claudeSessionMonitor.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to re-scan session state. Polling is what notices a session whose process died, since that produces no filesystem event.

claudeSessionMonitor.stuckAfterMinutes.description: Flag a busy session as possibly stuck when its status has not changed for this many minutes.

enumDescriptions: Open the chat in the Claude Code sidebar you already have open.
Open the chat as an editor tab, reusing an existing tab when there is one.
claudeSessionMonitor.openLocation.description: Where clicking a session takes you.

enumDescriptions: One sorted list, state as a stripe on the edge.
Bars showing how long each session has held its state, on a log scale.
Aligned columns. Densest, and the only style that holds up past eight sessions.
A sparkline of what each session has been doing over the last twenty minutes.

claudeSessionMonitor.showHeadline.description: Lift each blocked session into a card above the list, with the reason and a button.

claudeSessionMonitor.notifyWhenWaiting.description: Show a notification when a session newly needs you. Only transitions are announced, never the standing set.

claudeSessionMonitor.escalateAfterMinute.description: How long a session waits before the status bar turns from amber to red.

claudeSessionMonitor.statusBarPulse.description: Blink the status bar bell while a session is waiting.

claudeSessionMonitor.showIdle.description: List idle sessions. Turn off to show only what is working or blocked.

claudeSessionMonitor.claudeHome.description: Override the Claude home directory. Empty means ~/.claude.
